metricDefinitions.runCount: Number of input workloads evaluated by this policy, including empty workloads.
metricDefinitions.completedTasks: Sum of completedTasks across this policy's runs.
metricDefinitions.totalWaiting: Sum of totalWaiting across this policy's runs.
metricDefinitions.meanWaiting: totalWaiting / completedTasks; task-weighted, not a mean of run means; zero for no tasks.
metricDefinitions.maxWaiting: Maximum maxWaiting across this policy's runs; zero for no tasks.
metricDefinitions.totalTurnaround: Sum of totalTurnaround across this policy's runs.
metricDefinitions.meanTurnaround: totalTurnaround / completedTasks; task-weighted; zero for no tasks.
metricDefinitions.totalMakespan: Sum of per-run makespan; runs are separate episodes, not one continuous timeline.
metricDefinitions.pooledUtilization: totalBusyTime / totalMakespan; time-weighted, not a mean of run utilizations; zero for zero horizon.
